name: Cross-Stitch Sampler
desc: An embroidery sampler worked on toned aida cloth — floss X-stitches charting bordered folk motifs of hearts, flowers and stars, with blackwork line-fill and indigo sashiko running-stitch variants — the panel scrolling slowly under a travelling needle-glint as the floss catches the light.

scale.doc: stitch/count size (fewer, larger stitches at max)

style.doc: multicolor folk on tan linen / jewel on dark aida / monochrome redwork / Holbein blackwork line-fill / white sashiko on indigo
